A.title: Candidate A - the waystation is open
A.thesis: A working post. The counter, its canopy and the goods sit in one compact block on the north edge of the paved yard, lit and facing the road; the delivery cart stands apart to the south-west so the yard between them stays open. One landmark (the red canopy), one secondary mass (the cart), and a wide empty pavement in front of both.

B.title: Candidate B - the waystation was overrun
B.thesis: The same yard, after the post died. No canopy: a bracketed trophy skull stands where the counter was, and a diagonal of wreckage - broken cart, planks, flattened crate - runs from the south-west corner up to it, so the eye is dragged along the debris to the marker. Boulders have crept onto the paving from the cliff. One guttering lantern, no torch, and the moor is left to take the east side back.
